title: Meyerheim's 'Remains of the Meal'
content: Paul Meyerheim chose an unusual subject for this painting:Paul Friedrich Meyerheim (1842-1915)The Remains of the Mealoil on canvas 138.7 x 176.3 cm, 1879An outdoor meal that was abandoned by humans has become a feast for a flock of chickens and a couple of sparrows. The big rooster is the featured star of the action, strutting across the tablecloth.It's an interesting twist on the classic Dutch still life painting of a table after a meal, and a scenario that would have taken some imagination to assemble.
